entries.563d77a5bdefbdb9: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,757,350 million, an increase of 9.9% from the previous fiscal year. Energy & Healthcare increased revenue due to new consolidation of an energy-saving-related business and an increase in transactions, and Aviation & Social Infrastructure increased revenue due to an increase in defense-related transactions. Because a trading company records the gross amount of consideration as revenue when it transacts as the principal, revenue is a figure close to the scale of transactions and is not the company's profit itself.
